considered, not kept.reason: The processor control-unit state rule bars control and status registers that instruction writes, trap entry, trap return, or CSR reads set or return; the debug-run state and trigger-start request are kept separately as explicit exceptions (1074-1100, 1117-1224, 1631-1639).
The FSM state and its next-state sequencing only order instruction steps and are barred by the sequencing-state rule (351, 359-569).

considered, not kept.reason: The transfer-record and processor-control rules treat the instruction and its handshake fields as a relayed/control transfer rather than an independent conceptual asset of this control unit (364-370).
cnt_event and the multi-cycle monitor count only pace or detect execution steps, so the pacing-pulse and sequencing-state rules bar them as separate information (631-645, 1603-1616).
The trigger configuration registers and fired flag are processor control-unit state; only the trigger-start request is spared and retained as C5 (1215-1224, 1699-1707).
